narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Draw the head by hand, it will be round enough.
<bookmark mark='wobble'/>A hand-drawn curve wobbles, so some points are nearer the centre than others.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The compass keeps one distance fixed, so every point of the head is equally far.

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, see that the head is round. The body has four equal sides. The set square fits its corners.
<bookmark mark='match'/>The half circles are equal. Both eyes match when laid over each other.
